about_the_game:
THIS IS DEMO

CREATE YOUR OWN DIECAST COLLECTION

Earn points to build your own special die-cast car collection.


DRIFT  & EARN POINTS

Earn points by drifting, buy new cars with the points you earn.



HUNT  - BUY - SELL

Go through the stores one by one and find Rare cars.
Sell your old cars. Grow your collection.


3D OR LIST VIEW YOUR COLLECTION
You can see your collection on the wall in 3D, or by listing it via the menu. You can examine your cars in detail in 3D whenever you want and enjoy them.

REALISTIC
You will have more fun while creating your collection with realistic graphics.  It helps you feel as if you have actually purchased a diecast with realistic graphics. You can examine your collection in 3D realistic style whenever you want.
